description: Every UNKNOWN candidate of the TypeScript real-repo loop, frozen before the Tier 3a scanner changes. A candidate in this file must never simply be absent from a later scan of the same commit: it resolves to a permitted status with stronger evidence, or it stays UNKNOWN. Disappearance is a law L1 violation.

identity_migration.note: Configuration-key patterns now match on identifier boundaries, so the key ADS_API_VERSION no longer matches inside GOOGLE_ADS_API_VERSION. Each retired substring candidate maps to the candidate for the enclosing key at the same site, whose permitted set is the intersection of both. Credential keys moved from config_env_keys to identifiers, so the same observation is now a surface_reference claim; each retired config_reference id maps to the surface_reference candidate at the same site, carrying the same permitted set.
